# browserctrl

> Map Claude-in-Chrome device ids to the Chromium browser, profile, signed-in email and Claude account behind them, see which profiles are open right now, and resolve a nickname like `work chrome` to an id in one command. Supports multiple Claude accounts. CLI + Go library. Reads Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Arc and Chromium profile stores read-only: no browser flags, no network.

browserctrl is open source (khanakia/browserctrl). Everything runs locally and read-only; nothing is sent to the cloud.

Multiple Claude accounts: `list` shows a CLAUDE ACCOUNT column, because the MCP's list_connected_browsers only reports browsers signed in to the same Claude account as the session asking — a browser on another account is unreachable from it however open it is. The signed-in account is named by email; others show as "other account" and can be named with --account-alias, since Claude stores no email for them on disk.

Prerequisite: the Claude in Chrome extension must be installed in a profile for that profile to have a device id at all — the extension mints the id on its first run there, and Chrome scopes extensions per profile. A profile without it is invisible to browserctrl and to the MCP's own list_connected_browsers; `browserctrl list --profiles` shows which profiles are missing it.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/khanakia/browserctrl/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, usage, how it works, FAQ
- [Command reference](https://github.com/khanakia/browserctrl/blob/main/docs/commands.md): every verb and flag with real output, exit codes, JSON shape
- [Recipes](https://github.com/khanakia/browserctrl/blob/main/docs/recipes.md): Claude Code integration, shell and jq workflows, custom user-data dirs, test fixtures
- [Go API](https://github.com/khanakia/browserctrl/blob/main/docs/go-api.md): the `browser` and `browser/browsertest` packages

- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/khanakia/browserctrl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute, the rules the code follows

## Install
- Go: `go install github.com/khanakia/browserctrl@latest`
- Script: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khanakia/browserctrl/main/install.sh | sh`
- Library: `import "github.com/khanakia/browserctrl/browser"`
